name: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold7

sources.note: 207 entries on main at inspection; file moved here from playwright-core/src/server. viewport = layout viewport after browser UI; screen = full screen in CSS px.
Only the 8-inch main screen and 8.9 mm folded thickness rendered; the specification table did not render to a plain fetch, so panel resolution is NOT vendor-verified here.

Flex mode = FoldingFeature HALF_OPENED (POSTURE_HALF_OPENED); Samsung foldables report TYPE_FOLD; requires Jetpack WindowManager 1.0.0+. No hinge angle thresholds or screen dimensions published on the page.

State FLAT | HALF_OPENED; Orientation VERTICAL | HORIZONTAL; OcclusionType NONE (flexible screen, treat as guideline) | FULL (hinge is part of the window); isSeparating true for hinges always and for folds when not FLAT.
Candidate Recommendation Draft 2026-10-26. continuous = flat or fully closed; folded = book or laptop posture.
